title: Continuous Subarray Sum
description: Given an integer array nums and an integer k, return true if there is a continuous subarray of size at least two whose elements sum up to a multiple of k.
pseudocode:
1. map = {0: -1}
2. sum = 0
3. for i from 0 to nums.length - 1:
4.   sum = (sum + nums[i]) % k
5.   if sum in map:
6.     if i - map[sum] >= 2: return true
7.   else: map[sum] = i
8. return false

steps.note: Initialize remainder map with 0 at index -1 to handle subarrays starting from index 0.
Remainder 5 not in map, add it: {0: -1, 5: 0}.
Remainder 1 not in map, add it: {0: -1, 5: 0, 1: 1}.
Remainder 5 found in map at index 0.
